final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM album_stats) SELECT AVG(a.ratio), AVG(a.track_count), AVG(a.ratio - o.avg_ratio) FROM album_stats AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND a.ratio > o.avg_ratio
